allow..vscodeignore: vsce packaging reads .vscodeignore at the extension root by convention — it cannot live anywhere else.
allow.logo-red.svg: Extension runtime asset: src/ui/decorations.ts resolves it via context.asAbsolutePath('logo-red.svg'), so it must sit at the packaged extension root.
allow.logo-yellow.svg: Extension runtime asset: src/ui/decorations.ts resolves it via context.asAbsolutePath('logo-yellow.svg'), so it must sit at the packaged extension root.
allow.rolldown.config.mts: rolldown discovers its config at the repo root by convention — the extension bundle build reads it from there.
allow.vendor: Vendored WASM workspace packages (vendor/json-wasm, vendor/toml-wasm) wired into pnpm-workspace.yaml packages globs at these paths.
